notes: Yamamoto-first discovery pass under the current durable editorial rubric after rereading docs/PRIORITIES.md, docs/EDITORIAL.md, docs/DOMAINS.md, and radar/inbox/README.md. ALFIE, BODY&SOUL, current Tsuyoshi Yamamoto schedule traces, Space M&A, and current Japanese jazz sources produced no new unrecorded verified Yamamoto date. Three Visitors clears RADAR admission through the specific working-trio language of Edward Simon, Scott Colley, and Brian Blade around their 2024 album, with separate COTTON CLUB and Blue Note Tokyo engagements; both are A+ because the trio is unusually strong and worth actively making room for, while six Tokyo sets across three consecutive days remove S-level scarcity. Stanley Clarke and Hiromi with PUBLIQuartet at Strathmore clears admission through the personal Chick Corea lineage, bass-piano virtuosity, and improvising string-quartet setting; A+ is appropriate because the same tribute program tours multiple cities in 2027, so the North Bethesda performance is exceptional locally without being scarce enough for S. Proposed batch shape: A+ 3, A 0, S 0, S+ 0.

en.why_it_matters: The reason to care is the trio itself. Simon, Colley and Blade have enough shared language that the music can move without a fixed hierarchy: piano can become rhythm, bass can carry the melodic argument, and Blade can reshape the form without sounding like he is simply driving it. Three Visitors gives that chemistry an actual body of compositions, so this is a working ensemble rather than an all-star pickup date.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one set if December overlaps with Tokyo. The COTTON CLUB room should reward the trio's dynamics and small shifts in time, but the three-day Tokyo run gives enough flexibility that there is no need to sacrifice a genuinely singular master appearance elsewhere in Kanto.

es.why_it_matters: La razón para entrarle es el trío mismo. Simon, Colley y Blade tienen suficiente lenguaje compartido para que la música se mueva sin una jerarquía fija: el piano puede volverse ritmo, el bajo cargar el argumento melódico y Blade cambiar la forma sin limitarse a empujarla desde atrás. Three Visitors les da además un cuerpo real de composiciones, así que no es una fecha de estrellas armada para la ocasión sino un ensamble con identidad propia.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los sets si diciembre coincide con Tokio. COTTON CLUB debería favorecer muchísimo la dinámica y los pequeños desplazamientos de tiempo del trío; como hay una corrida de tres días en la ciudad, todavía dejaría precedencia a un maestro en contexto verdaderamente singular en otro punto de Kanto.

events.subtitle: A Celebration of the Music of Chick Corea and Beyond
events.factual_description: Strathmore presents Stanley Clarke and Hiromi featuring PUBLIQuartet at the Music Center at Strathmore on Thursday, April 8, 2027 at 8:00 PM. The program, A Celebration of the Music of Chick Corea and Beyond, combines Chick Corea compositions with new works inspired by his legacy. Strathmore identifies Clarke as Corea's longtime Return to Forever collaborator and notes that Hiromi's connection to Corea began when he invited her to perform with him in Tokyo at age 17. PUBLIQuartet adds an improvisation-oriented string-quartet voice. The same program is scheduled at other 2027 presenters, including Berklee, Krannert Center, Mesa Arts Center and CU Presents.

en.why_it_matters: This has a reason to exist beyond the tribute label. Clarke carries the Return to Forever side of Corea's history; Hiromi carries a direct personal and musical connection that began in Tokyo when she was still a teenager; PUBLIQuartet changes the physical vocabulary by putting an improvising string ensemble around bass and piano. The interesting question is how Corea's writing survives that combination without turning into repertory museum music.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for this locally. It is one of those Strathmore dates where the DMV gets a genuinely high-level intersection of living masters, the Japan thread and instrumental experimentation; because the same project tours several cities, there is no need to treat the North Bethesda stop as a scarcity event.
en.listen_before: Chick Corea & Hiromi — Duet; Stanley Clarke Trio — Jazz In the Garden

es.why_it_matters: Aquí sí hay una razón musical más allá de la etiqueta de homenaje. Clarke carga el lado Return to Forever de la historia de Corea; Hiromi trae una relación personal y musical que empezó en Tokio cuando todavía era adolescente; y PUBLIQuartet cambia el vocabulario físico al poner un cuarteto de cuerdas con vocación improvisadora alrededor del bajo y el piano. La pregunta interesante es cómo sobrevive la escritura de Corea dentro de esa combinación sin volverse música de museo.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente dentro del DMV. Es una de esas fechas de Strathmore donde se cruzan de verdad maestros vivos, el hilo de Japón y la experimentación instrumental; como el mismo proyecto circula por varias ciudades, no hace falta tratar la parada de North Bethesda como un acontecimiento escaso.
